data.text: Excess/additional samples may be stored for up to 5 years and used for PD and/or diagnostic biomarker development and research to understand the pathways associated with the mechanism of action of ALXN1840. These samples will not be used for genetic analyses (ie, RNA or DNA analyses).

data.text: A single biobanked serum sample will be collected predose from each participant to serve as a retained sample during the study. Samples will remain on site and will be discarded following the completion of the clinical study report. The sample will not be used for genetic testing.

data.text: Individuals who do not meet the criteria for participation in this study (screen failure) due to a reason that is expected to resolve or has resolved may be rescreened based on discussion and agreement between the Investigator and the Medical Monitor. data.sourceSection: Section 5.4 Screen Failures

data.text: If a clinically significant finding is identified (including, but not limited to changes from baseline in QT interval corrected using Fridericia's formula [QTcF]) after enrollment, the Investigator or qualified designee will determine if the participant can continue in the study and if any change in participant management is needed. This review of the ECG printed at the time of collection must be documented.
data.sourceSection: Section 7.1 Discontinuation of Study Intervention

data.text: Investigators are not obligated to actively seek AE or SAE data after conclusion of the study participation. However, if the Investigator learns of any SAE, including a death, at any time after a participant has been discharged from the study, and he/she considers the event to be reasonably related to the study intervention or study participation, the Investigator must promptly notify Alexion.
data.sourceSection: Section 8.3.1 Time Period and Frequency for Collecting AE and SAE Information

data.text: This study incorporates the use of an adaptive design. Adaptive features may be implemented at the discretion of the Investigator to support conduct of the study. Such adaptive features do not require amendment of the protocol.

data.text: As this study is an exploratory study, no formal hypothesis testing is being conducted. Study results will be summarized using descriptive statistics.

Protocol Amendment 3.1 (US) for Study ALXN1840_WD_204. Main reason for amendment was to clarify study procedures occurring across different sites in the US to facilitate participant recruitment across different regions of the US and to lessen inconvenience for participants without compromising study quality. Changes include: addition of footnote text in SoA Table 1 referencing Section 8 for US screening site procedures; correction of zinc discontinuation days from 30 to 21 days in Section 4.2; and addition of US_specific text in Section 8 detailing possibility for US sites to perform screening procedures only. Considered substantial per Article 10(a) of Directive 2001/20/EC and FDA regulation at 21 CFR part 312.30(b).

data.name: Copper- and Molybdenum-Controlled Diet
data.label: Controlled Diet
data.description: Controlled dietary regimen with defined copper and molybdenum content administered during inpatient Period 1 (Day -8 to Day 9) and inpatient Period 2 (Day 23 to Day 40); participants encouraged to adhere to copper-controlled diet during outpatient period

data.name: Intravenous Cannula
data.label: IV Cannula
data.description: Peripheral venous cannula placed to minimize needle sticks for repeated blood draws; must not be left in place longer than 72 hours and must be flushed minimum every 8 hours

data.name: Automated Blood Pressure Device
data.label: Automated BP Monitor
data.description: Completely automated device used for blood pressure and heart rate measurements; manual techniques used only if automated device is not available

data.name: 12-Lead ECG Machine
data.label: ECG Device
data.description: Device used to perform triplicate 12-lead electrocardiograms for assessment of heart rate, PR, QRS, QT, and QTcF intervals; ECG printed at time of collection for review

data.name: Large Water Bottle Dispenser
data.label: Water Dispenser
data.description: Shared large water bottle dispenser from which all participants drink during inpatient periods; water samples collected and analyzed for copper and molybdenum content

data.name: Age requirement
data.text: Participants aged ≥18 at the time of signing the ICF.

data.name: Wilson Disease diagnosis
data.text: Diagnosis of WD by Leipzig Criteria ≥ 4 documented by testing as outlined in the 2012 European Association for the Study of Liver WD Clinical Practice Guidelines (Ferenci, 2003; EASL, 2012) or by historical test results for WD including some or all of the following: Presence of Kayser Fleischer rings, Neurological symptoms, Serum ceruloplasmin below reference range, Coombs-negative hemolytic anemia, Elevated liver or urinary copper, Presence of mutations in the ATP7B gene, or Other, as considered appropriate, may be used instead to confirm the diagnosis of WD.

data.name: Benefit from decoppering therapy
data.text: Participants who in the opinion of the referring Investigator may benefit from decoppering therapy.

data.name: Ability to comply with study procedures
data.text: Participants must be able to comply with all study-related procedures.

data.name: Ability to reside in CRU
data.text: Participants must be able to reside in the CRU for intensive metabolic monitoring of copper and molybdenum.

data.name: Willingness to discontinue chelator therapy
data.text: Participants willing to discontinue chelator therapy for approximately 4 days prior to initiation of ALXN1840 to allow a baseline assessment of copper balance.

data.name: Adequate venous access
data.text: Participants with adequate venous access to allow collection of required blood samples.

data.name: Ability to swallow tablets
data.text: Participants must be able to swallow intact ALXN1840 tablets.

data.name: Willingness to avoid copper/zinc/molybdenum minerals
data.text: Participants willing to avoid use of minerals containing copper, zinc, or molybdenum throughout the study duration.

data.name: Willingness to adhere to controlled diet
data.text: Participants willing to adhere to copper/molybdenum-controlled diet during inpatient periods and willing to comply with a low copper dietary requirement during the Outpatient Period.

data.name: Contraceptive use requirement
data.text: Contraceptive use by men or women should be consistent with local regulations regarding the methods of contraception for those participating in clinical studies. a. Male participants: Male participants, if heterosexually active and with a female spouse or partner of childbearing potential or a pregnant or breastfeeding spouse or partner, must agree to use barrier contraception (male condom) for the duration of the study and for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Male participants must not donate sperm for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female spouses or partners of male participants who are of childbearing potential must use highly effective contraception as defined in Section 10.4, starting at least 1 menstrual cycle before (the male participant's) first study intervention administration and continuing until at least 3 months after the end of their male partner's systemic exposure to the study intervention. Barrier contraception (male condom) is required even with documented medical assessment of surgical success of a vasectomy. For male participants who have had a vasectomy (with documented evidence of azoospermia if possible) and agree to use a male condom for the stated time period, no additional contraceptive method is required by their female partner. b. Female participants: Female participants or female partners of male participants of childbearing potential (including breastfeeding females), if heterosexually active, must be willing to follow protocol-specified contraception guidance starting at least 1 menstrual cycle before first study intervention administration and continuing for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female participants must not donate ova for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female participants who are documented as being of non-childbearing potential as defined in Section 10.4 are exempt from contraception requirements. Highly effective contraceptive methods for female participants and female partners of male participants are described in Section 10.4.

data.name: Informed consent capability
data.text: Participants capable of giving signed informed consent, which includes compliance with the requirements and restrictions listed in the ICF and in this protocol.

data.name: Decompensated cirrhosis or MELD score
data.text: Decompensated cirrhosis or model for end-stage liver disease (MELD) score > 13.

data.name: Modified Nazer score
data.text: Modified Nazer score > 7 (Dhawan, 2005).

data.name: Clinically significant gastrointestinal bleed
data.text: Clinically significant gastrointestinal bleed within past 3 months.

data.name: ALT elevation
data.text: Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) > 2 × upper limit of normal (ULN).

data.name: Marked neurological disease
data.text: Marked neurological disease requiring assistance with self-care or activities of daily life.

data.name: Low hemoglobin
data.text: Hemoglobin less than lower limit of the reference range for age and sex.

data.name: Active viral infection or HIV seropositivity
data.text: Active infection with hepatitis B virus (positive hepatitis B surface antigen) or C virus (participants with positive hepatitis C antibody result would require confirmation of active disease with a positive hepatitis C polymerase chain reaction test), or seropositivity for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).

data.name: Significant medical history or current disorder
data.text: History or presence of/significant history of or current cardiovascular, respiratory, hepatic, renal, gastrointestinal, endocrinological, hematological, or neurological disorders, or psychiatric disorder that in the opinion of the Investigator may constitute a risk when taking the study intervention; or may interfere with the interpretation of data.

data.name: Previous treatment with ALXN1840 or tetrathiomolybdate
data.text: Previous treatment with ALXN1840 or other form of tetrathiomolybdate within 1 year prior to dosing.

data.name: Previous treatment with zinc
data.text: Previous treatment with zinc within 21 days prior to Day 1.

data.name: Experimental or unapproved therapy use
data.text: The use of an experimental or unapproved/unlicensed therapy at the same time or within 90 days or 5 half-lives, whichever is longer, prior to the Screening Visit.

data.name: Renal failure
data.text: Participants in renal failure, defined as in end-stage renal disease on dialysis (chronic kidney disease [CKD] stage 5) or creatinine clearance < 30 mL/min (Levey, 2006).

data.name: Pregnancy or breastfeeding
data.text: Pregnant (or females who are planning to become pregnant) or breastfeeding females (women of childbearing potential must have a negative serum pregnancy test result at screening).

data.name: Known sensitivity to ALXN1840
data.text: Known sensitivity to ALXN1840, ALXN1840 excipients (anhydrous dicalcium phosphate, anhydrous sodium carbonate), or any of the ingredients contained in ALXN1840 or related compounds.

data.name: Likely non-compliance
data.text: In the opinion of the Investigator, the participant and/or their legal guardian is likely to be non-compliant or uncooperative during the study.

data.name: History of illicit drug or significant alcohol abuse
data.text: History of illicit drug abuse, history of significant alcohol abuse within 1 year prior to the Screening Visit, or clinical evidence of substance and/or alcohol abuse within the 2 years before screening. Alcohol abuse is defined as regular weekly intake of more than 14 units (for both males and females), using the following National Health Service (NHS) alcohol tracker http://www.nhs.uk/Tools/Pages/drinks-tracker.aspx.

data.name: Positive urine drug toxicology screen
data.text: Positive urine drug toxicology screen at Screening or on Day -8 (cannabinoids will not be tested).

data.name: Alcohol consumption or positive alcohol breath test
data.text: Alcohol consumption within 48 hours prior to study intervention administration or positive alcohol breath test at screening or on Day -8.

data.name: Unwillingness to complete every meal and tolerate controlled menu
data.text: Participants unwilling to consistently complete every meal and tolerate a controlled, limited menu for the duration of the study.
